scope: Clarify Awoken acquisition eligibility versus actual transformation usability for Saiyan-exclusive god forms.

records.name: Super Saiyan God
records.reason: Future Warrior documentation states the skill can be obtained regardless of race, while the transformation itself is Saiyan-exclusive.

records.name: Super Saiyan God Super Saiyan
records.reason: Whis teaches the transformation regardless of the Future Warrior's selected race, but it can only be utilized by Saiyans.

records.name: Super Saiyan God Super Saiyan (Evolved)
records.reason: Future Warrior documentation describes the godly transformation progression as learnable regardless of race while actual use remains Saiyan-only.

note: Do not collapse acquisition_race_requirement into race_restriction. The latter records actual usability in the maintained canonical model.
